name: Dense Voxel Terrain Generation
definition: A compute shader generates a dense 3D voxel grid representing terrain by evaluating mathematical functions to determine if each voxel is empty or full.
summary: Dense Voxel Terrain Generation is a GPU-accelerated technique that produces a contiguous 3D voxel grid by evaluating mathematical functions, differing from sparse methods by allocating memory for every voxel to enable simple linear indexing.
